utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll send you a short list and a reminder before Saturday so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for your list and reminder before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — come by around 10 in the morning for the repair drive on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Rosa, that’s a big help. If they can, send them by the front porch this Saturday and I’ll get them sorted out!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Tess — I’ll pass that along for Saturday at the front porch and check with a neighbor or two as well.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. That helps a lot, and I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Uli — I’ll bring basic tools and gloves, and I’ll see you on the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Mina. I’ll round up a few handy folks and send them your way for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I show up on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, I’m still happy to help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch—just remind me what tools to bring, and I’ll do my best to show up ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren - it’s actually Sunday at the community center now, and if you can bring a basic toolkit and a neighbor or two, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. I’m still lining up a few more people for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’ll keep spreading the word for a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. I’m keeping a close tally for Saturday on the front porch, so please let me know if anyone else can help and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep asking around and send anyone handy your way for Saturday on the front porch. If they can bring tools or a little extra tape, that’d be a big help!

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
